name: PT. Arkora Hydro Tbk
summary: PT Arkora Hydro Tbk, an Indonesian enterprise, focuses on establishing and managing run-of-river hydroelectric facilities. The company aims to generate and supply renewable electricity to local communities. Currently, it oversees 17.4 megawatts of active hydropower plants and is developing an additional 10 megawatts of capacity across Java and Sulawesi. Founded in 2010, the company's headquarters are located in Jakarta, Indonesia.
